doc.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Hearing Artie Shaw and Hampton after high school
summary: After high school he heard Artie Shaw with Billie Holiday and Lionel Hampton, in the late 30s and early 40s.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: The swing music of the time that might have been coming through Ohio, did you have a chance to go out and hear any of the bands that you were hearing on the radio?
Well later after I graduated from high school I heard a couple of bands. I think I heard Artie Shaw’s band when he had Billie Holiday with him. And Lionel Hampton. And that’s about it.
So the swing era was kind of in full swing I should say?
Yeah. A lot of bands out there.
